name: ModelVariant782_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant782_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a flare drops onto the opposing slot, which then sits under a growing two-layer dome over a Gouraud base disc while debris sprites fly out, then the dome shrinks, a ring wave spreads and fades, the slot's height scale recovers and animated sparks rise and fall); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the debris and spark frames and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame with the camera orbiting and returns 0 before the start and dome times, 1 once when the flare lands and flattens the slot, 2 once the slot scale has recovered at the end and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-799 and 896 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
